# victorops_team_oncall_schedule (Data Source)

Get a team's on-call schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "victorops_team_oncall_schedule" "platform" {
  team_id      = victorops_team.platform.id
  days_forward = 14
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The slug/ID of the team.

### Optional

- `days_forward` (Number) The number of days in the future to include in the schedule.
- `days_skip` (Number) The number of days to skip.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `schedules` (List of Object) The policy schedules for the team. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))
- `team_name` (String) The name of the team.
- `team_slug` (String) The slug of the team.
